description: Paste a Celestia ERROR MESSAGE, stack trace, or error code and get the most likely resolved fixes from blobpedia history: forum threads where the same error was discussed, and related GitHub issues (each with its own date). Needs a literal error string or code; do NOT use it for symptom descriptions with no error text (e.g. "my node won't sync"), use semantic_search for those. Celestia-specific. Returns top matches from forum and github.

error_text.description: Error message, stack trace, or status code. Longer/more distinctive text returns better matches.

name: diagnose_error
